name: GameShelf
author: Alex
description: One bar icon for every game installed on this machine: Steam, Lutris, Heroic and any folder you point it at, grouped by where the game came from. Sources and folders are settings.

barWidget.description: Every installed game in one bar icon.

schema.label: Sources
schema.description: Comma-separated list of launchers to scan: steam, shortcuts, lutris, heroic, desktop, folders.

schema.label: Folders to scan
schema.description: Comma-separated folders searched for games when the folders source is on (up to three levels down).

schema.label: Hide (IDs)
schema.description: Comma-separated game IDs to never list, e.g. steam:892970 or file:/home/you/Downloads/Some.Game
